critical_steps: T is a closed-range nonorthogonal idempotent and K=I-T commutes with T with TK=0.
The singleton vector (-1,1) is an exact Parseval K-frame.
T annihilates the frame vector while K-star is nonzero on e1 in R(T).
TT-dagger is only the orthogonal projection onto R(T), so the proof requires K-star C-half f to remain in R(T).
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional scalar Hilbert-space specialization and direct Moore-Penrose projection calculation.

scientific_limitations: The finding corrects Theorem 3.5 only and does not reassess neighboring invariance or perturbation results.
K-star invariance of R(T) is a sufficient repair for the published proof, not claimed to be logically minimal in every special case.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same observation.
title: A nonorthogonal range invalidates a controlled \(K\)-frame invariance theorem
